title: Longest Substring Without Repeating Characters
hints: Keep a window of characters with no repeats. When a new character is already inside the window, which part of the window has to go?
Store each character's last index. When `ch` repeats inside the window, move `start` to just after its previous position. The answer is the largest `i - start + 1` you see.
Finding the longest run of days with temperatures above a threshold uses the same expanding and shrinking window.
